messages.content: Could you tell me the current weather in Boston, MA and also in San Francisco? Please provide the temperatures in Fahrenheit.

message.content:
I’m sorry—I don’t have real‑time browsing capability, so I can’t pull today’s exact temperatures for Boston or San Francisco right now.  

If you need the most accurate, up‑to‑date readings, try one of these quick options:

| City | Quick source |
|------|--------------|
| **Boston, MA** | National Oceanic & Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) – *weather.gov*; local news sites; smartphone weather apps |
| **San Francisco, CA** | California Climate Change Portal (*climate.ca.gov*); local news outlets; same weather apps |

These services will give you the latest forecast, including the current temperature in Fahrenheit, humidity, wind speed, and any alerts. If you’d like historical averages instead—like what the average high/low tends to be around this time of year—I can share those!
